attBesluta.text: Adekwatna cena do jakości. Drobne rysy i przetarcia nie przeszkadzają w użytkowaniu. Ma działać a nie perfekcyjnie wyglądać. Wiele opcji ustawienia Kojca.
We are using it at church entrance for a QR translator advertisement

Bought this to post our department’s info on our hallway in a hospital, and it’s serving its purpose. It’s very easy to assemble and adjust; and was put together in about 3-5 minutes. I actually spent more time creating the sign than I did assembling this sign holder. So far, it’s proven to have stability, durability, and definitely aesthetically pleasing. We’ve received many compliments on thinking outside the box from other departments and our ‘customers’ love the easy access to the information they need.
Easy to assemble. Well made. Sturdy and not heavy at all. Perfect for signage at our booth.
Love this!!! I use it for open houses to advertise the property!!! It does need sand or water in base to help from blowing over in strong winds but other than that it’s amazing
This is a little flimsy. It was easy to get my sign in it. Looked cute. Just a tad bit cheaply made
